measurement_scopes.native_seconds: 24 epochs including V scoring/selection and RAM state capture; synchronized process wall
measurement_scopes.source_seconds: 12 pilot passes plus T0 source standardization, teacher conversion check and RAM state capture
measurement_scopes.common_prefix_seconds: Native+source timers plus native and source caches, other prefix work; counted once per dataset/seed
measurement_scopes.adaptation_training_seconds: 20 epochs including V scoring, selection, per-epoch output and RAM selected/final capture; excludes final V/Q exports, functional diagnostics and latency benchmark
measurement_scopes.diagnostic_seconds: diagnose() timer, F/S/Q functional probes; excludes latency benchmark
measurement_scopes.latency: 50 warmup+200 synchronized measurements for raw_X and cached_prefix, batch1/256; P50/P95 do not reconstruct benchmark total wall
measurement_scopes.benchmark_observed_interval: costs.json mtime minus diagnostics.json mtime includes latency benchmark, MAC inventory and cost receipt generation; filesystem observation, not pure algorithm timer
measurement_scopes.unseparated_costs: Final V/Q exports, latency benchmark total, data loading/preparation, and E evaluation have no independent algorithm timer; worker timeline residual must not be labeled training
measurement_scopes.waiting: READY-to-E release residence, excluded from algorithm training; report explicit runner times and file-mtime observations separately
measurement_scopes.worker_complete: COMPLETE total_worker_wall_seconds includes RAM waiting and final E work; never sum as training
measurement_scopes.historical: Original attempts and diagnostic replays are repeated compute costs, not independent seeds or matrix completion
measurement_scopes.row_data_storage: Current .npy/.npz file sizes, deduplicated by filesystem inode for unique bytes; no model state serialization
measurement_scopes.MAC: Partial linear-layer inventory with explicit residual/lowrank terms separate; not full FLOPs and not sparse speedup
